svg.title: Site map, with a status on every page
svg.desc: Every page, the state of the server work behind it, and what a visitor or a staff member actually clicks. Menu, search and footer links are left out on purpose: drawn, they turn the arrows into a web. Dashed arrows are staff actions that reach a customer page.
